$sources: ASCE 7-22 Chapter 11 (seismic design criteria) and Chapter 12 (seismic design requirements for building structures)
ACI 318-19 Sec 18.2.1 (seismic detailing by Seismic Design Category)

SA.description: Site class A: hard rock (vs30 above 1524 m/s)

SB.description: Site class B: medium hard rock (vs30 914-1524 m/s)

SBC.description: Site class BC: soft rock (vs30 640-914 m/s)

SC.description: Site class C: very dense sand or hard clay (vs30 442-640 m/s)

SCD.description: Site class CD: dense sand or very stiff clay (vs30 305-442 m/s)

SD.description: Site class D: medium dense sand or stiff clay (vs30 213-305 m/s)

SDE.description: Site class DE: loose sand or medium stiff clay (vs30 152-213 m/s)

SE.description: Site class E: very loose sand or soft clay (vs30 below 152 m/s)

SF.description: Site class F: soils needing a site response analysis (Sec 20.2.1)

driftLimits.label: 4 storeys or less (not masonry shear walls), finishes and partitions designed for the storey drift

inPlaneDiscontinuity.label: In-plane discontinuity in vertical lateral force-resisting element irregularity (vertical type 4)

weak.label: Discontinuity in lateral strength-weak story irregularity (vertical type 5a)

clauses.strength: ACI 318-19 Sec 22.5.5.1 and 22.5.8.5.3 (shear strength of the columns and walls); the BNBC 2020 Chapter 6 form SAEngine uses until the ACI pack

sources.designSpectrum: ASCE 7-22 Sec 11.4: SDS = (2/3) SMS, SD1 = (2/3) SM1 (Eqs 11.4-3, 11.4-4); the two-period spectrum of Sec 11.4.6 (T0 = 0.2 SD1/SDS, TS = SD1/SDS, Sa = SDS(0.4 + 0.6 T/T0) below T0); the multi-period spectrum (Sec 11.4.5.1); SMS, SM1 from the multi-period MCER spectrum by Sec 21.4 (0.9 x the largest Sa from 0.2 to 5 s; the largest T Sa from 1 to 2 s, 1 to 5 s for vs30 at most 442 m/s); SDC bands of Tables 11.6-1 (SDS 0.167, 0.33, 0.50) and 11.6-2 (SD1 0.067, 0.133, 0.20), E/F where S1 >= 0.75 (Sec 11.6); Cs of Sec 12.8.1.1, at least 0.044 SDS Ie and 0.01 (Eq 12.8-5), 0.5 S1/(R/Ie) where S1 >= 0.6 (Eq 12.8-6); Cu of Table 12.8-1
sources.siteClasses: ASCE 7-22 Table 20.2-1, the classes by vs30 (ft/s 5000, 3000, 2100, 1450, 1000, 700, 500 in m/s); ids keep SAEngine's S prefix
sources.systems: ASCE 7-22 Table 12.2-1: R, Omega0, Cd and the height limits for SDC B-F (NL: empty, NP: 0; 160 ft = 48.8 m, 100 ft = 30.5 m, 35 ft = 10.7 m); the rows SAEngine designs
sources.designCategories: ASCE 7-22 Tables 11.6-1 and 11.6-2 by the band of SDS and SD1 (saengine.fem.spectral_hazard.band), the 5th band S1 >= 0.75 (Sec 11.6): one row for every site class
sources.requiredDetailing: ACI 318-19 Sec 18.2.1: ordinary (B), intermediate (C), special (D-F) systems of concrete
sources.driftRedundancyCategories: ASCE 7-22 Sec 12.12.1.1: moment frames in SDC D-F, Delta_a / rho
sources.separation: ASCE 7-22 Sec 12.12.3: delta_M to the property line, sqrt(delta_M1² + delta_M2²) between units; no reduction for aligned floors
sources.irregularities: ASCE 7-22 Tables 12.3-1 and 12.3-2; nonparallelTolerance 5 degrees (the table says only 'not parallel') and inPlaneOffset 0.01 x the length (the table counts any in-plane offset that loads the supporting members) are SAEngine practice
sources.diaphragmConnections: ASCE 7-22 Sec 12.3.3.4: +25 % on the connection forces in SDC D-F with horizontal irregularities 1a, 1b, 2, 3, 4 or vertical 4
sources.liveShare: ASCE 7-22 Sec 12.7.2: 25 % of the floor live load in areas used for storage; SAEngine takes live loads above 100 psf (4.79 kN/m²) as storage (SAEngine practice; the mass source may override)
sources.partitionWeight: ASCE 7-22 Sec 12.7.2: the partition weight (at least 10 psf) in W
sources.minimumScale: ASCE 7-22 Sec 12.9.1.4.1: the modal base shear scaled to 100 % of the equivalent lateral force V
sources.massParticipation: ASCE 7-22 Sec 12.9.1.1 (90 % of the mass in each direction, the alternative to 100 % with a residual mode)
sources.torsionAmplificationMax: ASCE 7-22 Sec 12.8.4.3, Eq 12.8-14: Ax at most 3.0
sources.pgaFactor: ASCE 7-22 Sec 11.4.6: Sa at T = 0 is 0.4 SDS; with Z = SDS and S = 1 a_h = 0.4 SDS (SAEngine's mapping)
sources.verticalFactor: ASCE 7-22 Sec 12.4.2.2: Ev = 0.2 SDS D = 0.5 x a_h D
sources.periodUpperFactor: ASCE 7-22 Table 12.8-1 (Cu for SD1 >= 0.3); the site's Cu by SD1 replaces it
sources.stabilityGravity: ASCE 7-22 Sec 12.8.7: Px with no load factor above 1.0
sources.stability: ASCE 7-22 Eq 12.8-16: theta = Px Delta Ie / (Vx hsx Cd) with Delta = Cd delta_e / Ie, so theta = Px delta_e / (Vx hsx); theta_max = 0.5/(beta Cd) <= 0.25 (Eq 12.8-17, beta = 1); below 0.10 P-Delta need not be considered
sources.dampingCorrection: ASCE 7-22 Sec 11.4.6: a 5 % damped spectrum, no damping correction in Ch 11-12
